title: Egunsentia
summary: Post-war underground civilization in the inherited metro of the Republic of Herria. Year 105 AW. Population known ~60,000. The surface is radioactive, cold, and monster-haunted. The metro is city, farm, archive, border and family memory.

title: The Catastrophe
summary: Nuclear bombardment at Year 0. About 200,000 reached the giant underground system. Factions formed later through scarcity, geography and civil wars, not on Day One.

title: Forty-two lines
summary: Original metro: 42 four-lane lines. 27 active/used, 15 Lost Lines. Lost does not mean empty. Tunnel 18 incident and burial of 17–22 remain UNKNOWN. Tunnel 19 (the Gate) stayed whole inside the collapse zone.

title: Historical periodization
summary: Pre-war Herria → Year 0 rupture → Foundation → First Monster War (Y22) → Civil War I (29–46) → Civil War II / Demos independence (46) → Great Famine → Great Separation (~70) → Civil War III and Armistice of 75 (75–77, expires end of 110) → fragile peace, Year 105 AW.

title: Monarchia — Concord of Houses
summary: Institutional continuity through lineage. High Seat: Lord Rainer von Moren. Founding houses Ardan, Veyr, Khar, Eld, Moren, Ravan. Water, ceremony, diplomacy. Adelheid is the marriage bridge to Red Claws.

title: Red Claws — House of the Fist
summary: Militarized defensive civilization under Christian Red IV. 12,500 people. Mark IV 960 ready + 40 repair. Three internal blocs: Old Guard, Banners, Works. Bound labor remains a moral fault line.

title: Grotsen Dominion
summary: Centralized order under Lord Viktor Grotsen. Succession unsettled between Ivo and Anselm. Mass rifles, discipline, Revolution Day. Vera is the marriage bridge. Hostile with Survivors.

title: The Demos — the Forum
summary: Participatory government under President Mirela Hartmann. Archives, education, technical argument. Limited military. Tension over the hidden Archive. Tunnel 37 breach is an INITIAL REPORT only.

title: Survivors — Great Alliance
summary: Coalition under Great Unifier Vojtech Greywolf. Mobility, ecological knowledge, Pathwalkers. Envoy Bohdan presses union. Distrust of Grotsen; conflict with Red Claws over bonded labor.

title: Mark IV heritage armor
summary: ~2.1 m worn, ~90 kg, radioisotope heart cell, hydraulic assist, magnetic anti-contamination layer not fully understood. 1,000 House suits; no manufacturing of true replacements from ordinary production.

title: Water as leverage
summary: Springs, pumps, reservoirs, condensation, filtration. West cistern currently reported at 18% — INITIAL REPORT from Warden Tomas, not yet a confirmed failure.

title: Christian Red IV
summary: Age 35. Fist of the Red Claws. Player character. Son of Christian III and Katharina Red; raised in part by Mirelda Grotsen after Katharina's death. The AI never chooses his speech, feelings, consent or decisions.

title: Dagmar Red
summary: First Wife, 37. Frontier and border command. Mother of Konrad and Liese. Watchful, scar through left eyebrow.

title: Adelheid von Moren
summary: Second Wife, 24. Monarchian diplomatic bridge. Mother of Emil. Ash-blond, formal, lavender and silk against iron.

title: Vera Grotsen
summary: Third Wife, 19. Grotsen political bride. Compact, stern, watches doors. Anselm still expects information; she is increasingly unwilling.

title: Elara Red
summary: Iron Guard commander. Former lover. Mother of Luka. Secret leader of the unnamed black-layer intelligence organization — existence known to her and Christian only.

title: Haragi-Jalea
summary: First major species, Year 22, First Monster War.

title: Azken-Gizona
summary: Unresolved entity associated with fragmented human-looking reports. Human-face reports are not proof of intelligence, mimicry, origin or the supernatural. Mystery M6.

title: West cistern failure
summary: Tomas reports 18%. Truth status: UNVERIFIED / INITIAL REPORT. Secret Clock SC-cistern tracks risk without proving collapse.

title: Sixth Carrier answers questions
summary: A child claims the radio can answer questions on 108.0. Truth: UNVERIFIED. The tone itself is OBSERVED after midnight.

title: Official household
summary: Three wives only: Dagmar First, Adelheid Second, Vera Third. Older V14 numbering (Adelheid Third / Vera Fourth) is superseded. No fourth wife.
evidence: V4.1 Super Lore Critical Household Normalization

title: North Gate
summary: Principal controlled opening for visitors, Survivors and northern external rail. Current visual state: NORMAL.

title: East Gate
summary: Monster-facing. Founder monument. Current alert elevated; Thread A. Visual state: NORMAL with heightened watch, not combat.

title: West Gate
summary: Monarchia and internal/military traffic. Visual state: NORMAL.

title: South Gate
summary: Industrial and southern logistics. Southern rail domestic only. Visual state: NORMAL.

title: Where the pre-war film was shot
summary: A skyline reel exists in the Hall projector. Location of the shoot is unresolved Mystery M3. A film cannot settle the mystery by suggestion.
